page.overview:
Who is Caren Endelle?

Caren Endelle is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah., Caren Endelle}} She was part of Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

Caren is is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . Along with Bennae Nalsad and Nisain a'Cowel, she is the joint fourth weakest Aes Sedai about which we have information.

After kidnapping Rand and escaping capture during the Battle of Dumai's Wells she flees to Dorlan.

=Trivia== Caren Endelle is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
